properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 1 at 3:19PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Cotulla, Tilden, Three Rivers,
Mathis, Bluntzer, Calallen...Major flooding is forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Nueces River near Tilden.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 20.0 feet, Major flooding below Cotulla to below
Tilden occurs, and cuts off extensive portions of the flood plain,
requiring wholesale evacuation of livestock from the area. Roads
and bridges near the river flood severely. Hunting cabins, pump
jacks, tank batteries, irrigation pumps and any equipment in low
areas near the river flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 2:30 PM CDT Saturday the stage was 19.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 11.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall into moderate flood
stage by Sunday night, then fall into minor flood stage by
Wednesday night.
- Flood stage is 14.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

at 10 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels and create locally hazardous seas. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess
of 34 knots, suddenly higher waves, lightning and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life jackets.

Port Canaveral, Jetty Park, Cape Canaveral, Cocoa Beach, and Merritt
Island.
properties.instruction:

overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

be anticipated across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away
in places. If you encounter flood waters, climb to safety.
